Description:
Jira kanban board, AWS account hardening, repo scaffold, 2026 spec verification, local tooling. Foundation epic - do not skip.
Acceptance criteria:
- Board visible with columns and WIP limits
- All epics and stories present and epic-linked
- Local tooling green

MVP ingestion tier: API Gateway -> Lambda -> S3, one JSON line per event, date-partitioned. First end-to-end demo lands here.
Acceptance criteria:
- POST /events yields 200 and a visible S3 object
- Invalid payloads rejected
- API key auth works

Enrich raw events (UA parse, IP geo, event_day, is_bot, currency normalization) and dedupe via DynamoDB event_id.
Acceptance criteria:
- Enriched fields present on every landed record
- Re-POST of same event_id does not duplicate

Production-grade path: Kinesis Data Firehose buffers and converts to Parquet + GZIP with dynamic partitioning.
Acceptance criteria:
- Parquet objects land with bounded partition keys only
- Both tiers remain demoable

Glue table over Tier A output with partition projection, SQL library, headless Athena smoke script.
Acceptance criteria:
- Partition projection answers queries on a new day without MSCK REPAIR
- All SQL queries execute against live data

GitHub Actions: test gates on PR, deploy dev on push, deploy prod on main behind environment approval.
Acceptance criteria:
- Red tests block merge
- Dev and prod stacks deploy via pipeline
- Prod requires manual approval

CloudWatch dashboard widget set and SNS alarms defined in IaC.
Acceptance criteria:
- Dashboard widgets move after a demo-generator run
- Injected failure trips alarm and sends email

README with architecture, cost table, demo script. 5-minute interview arc.
Acceptance criteria:
- Stranger can deploy and query from README alone
- Talk track written and rehearsed

Summary: Create Jira project and kanban board; import backlog
Description:
Company-managed Kanban project (hierarchy import requires company-managed in Jira Cloud). Columns: Backlog - Ready - In Progress - Review - Done. WIP limits: In Progress 2, Review 1. Import this CSV via Administration - System - External system import - CSV; map Parent column to link stories to epics.
Acceptance criteria:
- Board visible with columns and WIP limits set
- All 8 epics and 26 stories present, epic-linked, in order
- Definition of Done pasted into project description

Summary: Configure AWS account with MFA access and budget alarm
Description:
Create AWS account admin user with MFA, configure CLI. Arm a $5 cost budget alarm from day one.
Acceptance criteria:
- aws sts get-caller-identity returns expected account
- $5 budget alarm armed

Summary: Initialize GitHub repo and SAM project skeleton
Description:
git init, sam init with Python 3.12 template, .gitignore, README stub, push to public GitHub repo named eventpulse.
Acceptance criteria:
- sam build and sam validate pass locally
- Repo live on GitHub

Summary: Verify 2026 AWS specifics against official docs
Description:
Pin live facts before building: (a) aws-sam-actions/deploy-cloudformation-stack@v2 maintained vs direct aws cloudformation deploy, (b) Firehose buffering limits, (c) Glue partition projection still the no-crawl path, (d) Athena pricing per TB scanned. Record all in docs/decisions.md.
Acceptance criteria:
- docs/decisions.md updated with versions, limits, prices
- Any drift from plan recorded as corrections

Summary: Set up local tooling and tests
Description:
Python venv, pytest, sqlfluff, sam local smoke test. Makefile with test/lint targets.
Acceptance criteria:
- make test green
- sqlfluff lints repo SQL (empty set initially)

Summary: Define SAM template for Tier A stack
Description:
REST API gateway, Ingest Lambda, S3 bucket, IAM roles in one template.yaml. Deploy to dev stack.
Acceptance criteria:
- sam deploy creates the stack
- endpoint returns 200 on POST /events

Summary: Implement ingest Lambda writing events to S3
Description:
Validate JSON, set event_ts, write one JSON line (gzip) to s3://bucket/events/YYYY/MM/DD/. First end-to-end demo: POST -> API Gateway -> Lambda -> visible S3 object.
Acceptance criteria:
- Test POST lands a gzip object under correct date prefix
- Event record content matches input

Bad payloads return 400 with field-level reason; errors logged to CloudWatch. Table-driven pytest coverage.
Acceptance criteria:
- Malformed payload -> 400 with reason
- Tests cover missing fields, bad types, bad JSON

Summary: Add API key auth via Usage Plan
Description:
API key + usage plan per environment; key as request header.
Acceptance criteria:
- Missing or bad key -> 403
- Valid key -> 200

scripts/generate_events.py: inline 5000 realistic events (page_view, add_to_cart, purchase, error) and POST them.
Acceptance criteria:
- 5000 requests accepted without errors
- Objects landed in S3

UA parse (device/browser), IP to geo country, event_day derived, is_bot flag, currency-normalized amount via rates dict. Unit tests per enrichment.
Acceptance criteria:
- Enriched fields present on every landed record
- Unit tests green for each enrichment

DynamoDB table keyed on event_id; ingest skips duplicates. Re-POST safe.
Acceptance criteria:
- Re-POST same event_id creates no second S3 object
- Concurrent duplicates handled (conditional put)

Summary: Add Firehose stream with dynamic partitioning
Description:
Firehose buffers to target 64 MiB / 60 s, Parquet + GZIP conversion, dynamic partitioning to events/event_type=.../year=.../month=.../day=.../. Bounded keys only.
Acceptance criteria:
- Parquet objects appear with expected partition layout
- Partition keys bounded (event_type, never user_id)

Summary: Create Glue table over Tier B output
Description:
External table matching Firehose Parquet output; queryable from Athena.
Acceptance criteria:
- Athena SELECT works on Firehose-parquet data

Move Tier A Lambda from direct S3 write to Firehose; separate endpoint path keeps both tiers demoable.
Acceptance criteria:
- Both tiers land data end-to-end
- Existing Tier A S3 layout still works

Summary: Create Glue table with partition projection for Tier A
Description:
day DATE partition key, projection.day.format = yyyy/MM/dd, range 2024-01-01 to NOW.
Acceptance criteria:
- Query on brand-new day returns rows without MSCK REPAIR or crawl

sql/ dir, sqlfluff-clean: (1) daily revenue + active users + window/FILTER aggregates, (2) top products by revenue with RANK(), (3) funnel per country (add_to_cart rate, conversion rate).
Acceptance criteria:
- All queries execute against live data
- sqlfluff passes on sql/

scripts/athena_example.py via boto3 runs the SQL library and prints row counts.
Acceptance criteria:
- Script runs, prints row counts, exits 0

Summary: Add CI test gate to PRs
Description:
GitHub Actions test job: pytest, sqlfluff, sam validate on every PR.
Acceptance criteria:
- Red tests block merge
- Green run passes

Push to dev triggers build and sam deploy to eventpulse-dev stack, assume-role via configure-aws-credentials@v4.
Acceptance criteria:
- Merge to dev updates dev stack
- Deploy artifacts reusable for prod

Push to main triggers deploy to eventpulse-prod behind GitHub environment with manual approval and concurrency guard; --no-fail-on-empty-changeset.
Acceptance criteria:
- Prod stack deploys only on approved runs
- No-op changesets do not fail the run

Summary: Publish stack outputs to workflow summary
Description:
API URL and dashboard link echoed into run summary and README quick-start.
Acceptance criteria:
- Run summary shows live endpoint

Widgets: API call count, 5xx count, Lambda invocations/errors, duration p95, S3 puts per day.
Acceptance criteria:
- Widgets show movement after demo-generator run

API 5xx > 0 (1 period) and Lambda error > 0 notify via SNS email.
Acceptance criteria:
- Injected failure trips alarm, email received

Architecture diagram (POST -> API GW -> Lambda -> S3/Firehose -> Athena), cost table under $3/mo, demo script, why-each-piece.
Acceptance criteria:
- Stranger deploys and queries from README alone

5-minute arc: problem, architecture, failure demos (idempotency, partition projection), cost story. Rehearse; optional Loom recording.
Acceptance criteria:
- Script written and walked through
- Optional recording saved
